description: Ministry of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine - Amendment of Sri Lanka Nursing Service Minute published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1837/8 of 19.11.2013
reasoning: This gazette notification amends the Sri Lanka Nursing Service Minute, specifically addressing recruitment, selection criteria, and training requirements for nursing staff. It deals with public service recruitment procedures, qualification standards, and service conditions for government nursing personnel, which falls under Public Service Gazettes (Type 8) rather than government structure/personnel changes. The content focuses on administrative regulations for public sector employment rather than naming specific individuals or describing government organizational changes.
